strategy.skills: symlink each selected skills/<name> into ~/.agents/skills/<name> (or ./.agents/skills with --project); selection by --pack
strategy.shared: symlink shared/references into <skills folder>/../shared/references (a copy with --copy), in a folder holding the installer's marker, so that a skill's ../../shared/references/<file> resolves

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: run the eval runs of a model served through OpenRouter, and the runtime's model calls through the API adapter when its model is openrouter/<vendor>/<model>
secrets.permission: a key used only for evals and the runtime; a credit limit on it is recommended
secrets.note: in an eval run the value never enters the run container: the key proxy (evals/container/keyproxy/) holds it and adds it to each call, and the run gets a placeholder and the proxy's base URL in OPENROUTER_BASE_URL

secrets.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: run the eval runs of a model served through DeepSeek's own API, when its id is deepseek/<model>
secrets.permission: a key used only for evals; a spending limit on it is recommended

secrets.name: EXA_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: web search of the eval runs of the cases that use the open network (web_cases of evals/eval-gate.json) on a model of this adapter: the runner reads it as EXA_API_KEY and calls Exa with it; without it every search goes to Exa's free endpoint, which answers HTTP 429
secrets.permission: an Exa API key with a low spend limit, used for evals only: it is passed into the run on the open network, which reads pages written by others, so a leak costs at most the key's limit
secrets.note: unlike the model's key, this value is in the run's environment (the runner reads it there, and puts it in the query of its search call); only a model entry that lists it in web_pass_env receives it, and only on a web case
